steps.content: You dream again.
The dream is still shrouded in fog, with that familiar source of warmth by your side, quietly lingering.
You reach out, touching the edge, and instantly light bursts forth, dispersing the fog around.
Hehe... then take it to heart—this is the warmth of the sun.
Whenever this sunlight shines, it should be time to wake up.
All creatures, at this moment... all wake up.
You struggle to open your eyes, seeking the source of the speaking voice.
Through the haze, the heat source approaches you, and you feel as if a feather brushed across your forehead.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Whoa, you still remember me?
The familiar smiling face comes into view, Yao, as before, is leaning over the bed, looking down at you from above.
Her feathers beside her fall on your face, radiating warmth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's been a while.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Right, it's been a long time. You were so badly injured. You've been lying here for three years.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Look, my hair has even grown longer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know I can tell the time with the clock on my desk, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I should have gone unconscious for just three days.
Yao turns her head away for a while, and you hear her let out a slight "tsk."

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: There's an old saying from Eastia. You've probably heard of it.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: "A single day apart feels like three autumns." So, let's just say I haven't seen you for three years, alright?
You prop yourself up, sitting against the headboard.
Yao pours a cup of water from the side and hands it to you, trying to make out a taste.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you've been waiting here for me to wake up?
Yes, she's been there almost every second.
Wynn comes in through the door, carrying a stack of files, and places them with a thud beside your bed.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hehe, excuse me Chief! The head officer said, as soon as you wake up, you have to sign all these documents immediately.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Nightingale and I have protested for you many times, but they say these are related to the calamity, and must be dealt with as quickly as possible.
Wynn smiles apologetically at you and Yao.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Miss Yao has already controlled the Sun Crow Apostle and resumed being the Great Seer, so why the rush?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: ...Huh, don't get it...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: It's related to the calamity, so everyone just wants to address it quickly after all.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: And... I still don't remember much, so I'm not the seer as yet.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Understood... then... among the things you remember, is it true you can channel gods?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Oh. That, yes, that's true.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I once found someone's great grandfather to help convince that person to leave home and flee from disaster.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Whoa—That's amazing!!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Oh, and they also say, the Great Seer has read many books, seen a lot of things, and has her unique vision of the world, and can even communicate with all beings!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Is that also true?
Wynn hops over to Yao, who gently taps her nose, smiling as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: This is what a seer should do. Just like you, as a member of the Bureau, there are things you know that I don't.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I might need to ask you for help sometime.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Aww... Great Seer, you're so good! If there's anything Wynn can help with, please don't hesitate to ask!
As you watch Wynn leave with eyes full of admiration, you pick up the documents and speak in a faint voice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Great Seer, huh...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Heh, stop it. Show some respect, would you? You might actually have to call me "big sis" if we're talking about age.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Believe it or not, I have a clip of you calling me "big bro" on my terminal.
steps.female_content: Believe it or not, I have a clip of you calling me "big sis" on my terminal.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Sorry, but your terminal was smashed in WhiteSands.
The DisCity Hound and the Eastern Sun Crow face off with a smile for a while, both breaking into laughter.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I got it, people from legends are really good at messing with others.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's left, no need to keep sitting upright.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Quite a keen eye, huh?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your legs have been shaking, I saw it.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I've deceived all of them, making them believe I'm the seer. I've made things easier for you, right?
Yao shrugs her shoulders, moves the chair away, and sits beside you.
Golden feathers spread across the plain room, just like sunlight shining in.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Fortunately, you woke up.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Didn't cause a scene.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've always chosen us, and I should have noticed sooner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We thought about the escalation of the calamity but didn't want to face it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: On the surface, everyone looks down on those chasing myths, but who isn't the person longing for miracles?
You open the latest report, which describes everything happening in WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: The Apostle of Ashes has grown again, proving that the Mania that births the Tide of Ashes is also getting stronger.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I never wished to deify myself... but now I'm grateful, that I've made the myth a reality again, to protect you well.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You made the myth come true again in Sunsink.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This myth wasn't created by you, Xu.
At the mention of the familiar name, Yao pauses, her gaze wandering.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shackles can't lie, Yao.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You might deceive others into thinking your memory has returned and you've become the seer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you can't fool me... and there's no need to hide anything from me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: From the beginning to now, I've always considered you as <color=#fb9259>Yao</color>, and being <color=#fb9259>Yao</color> is enough for me.
Yao buries her head even lower, slowly leaning forward to rest on your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: No way. I've been doing this for days...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: They all say I've been good, surely I have turned human again and become the seer everyone thought I am.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Only you saw through me at a glance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I raised you, of course, I know you best.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Then I guess I will have to try harder to mess around with you.
Yao doesn't lift her head, and you feel the temperature on your shoulder rising.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, you can still hear their call, can't you?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...Yes.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: At every moment, I can feel the call from the calamity.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I want to fly out of here. I want to enter the Tide of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I want to eliminate more calamitous apostles, it's my instinct, and my duty.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You were meant for a much broader world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The appearance of higher-level Apostles of Ashes indicates that Mania is strengthening the Tide of Ashes. The former seer, even if shattered and reborn as a beast, would return to this world to protect humanity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now her life has entered the next stage, leaving only this obsession. And you, born from this obsession, how could you lack such a desire?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: But I can't bear to leave.
Yao lifts her head, staring at you like a child, unwilling to let go.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I can't, and I'm also afraid...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: The way you ran towards me recklessly in the WhiteSands, and these past few days of unconsciousness—it scared me too much. I was afraid you wouldn't come back.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: So even if I have to stay in this cage, even if I have to tell lies I'm not good at, pretending to be that person and deceiving all humans...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I can do it.
You smile and reach out to touch her forehead, remembering when she was in her juvenile form, she would burrow into your palm, rubbing against your hand and nodding happily.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How could I bear to leave you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But...
You hand the report to Yao, pointing out the current page for her to see.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But it must be suffocating, right? I can tell your feathers are dwelling. Although acting as the seer is quite good, you're definitely not happy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Here, you have to fight against your instincts, endure the whispers tempting you. And being in a crowd must be uncomfortable, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't want to see you like this, I'd rather see the person who bravely hunts Apostles in the storms of the WhiteSands, the god-like person who is surrounded by the splendid wild flames.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry.
You smile at her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You don't need to worry about me, I can't bear to see you sad, how could I let myself make you sad?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, you shouldn't and don't need to shrink in this tiny birdcage, becoming a flappy bird.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: You're the one who's flappy. You're the birdbrain, hmph!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did I say anything about birdbrain?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Your eyes did.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your instincts are as sharp as a wild beast's, you can even notice that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, follow your instincts, they've been there since you were born.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then, fly to a bigger, more suitable world for you.
You give Yao a hug, just like you used to.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you must take good care of yourself, don't be too reckless, don't push yourself too hard, otherwise, I won't be at ease letting you return to the Tide of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Says you, you're the one who's always reckless, pushing yourself...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Don't worry about me. I've grown. But I can feel it, the source of DisSea, calamity, is all related to you—if not, they wouldn't have sensed you so precisely in the WhiteSands before.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: We're both given fates that require us to fight with all our might... I promise I won't act recklessly, and I hope every time I miss you, I'll be able to see you here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I promise you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You must.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll miss you a lot if you go.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Okay, I will.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Gosh... is our air-con broken?

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Why does it keep getting so hot after a while?

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: So it's not just me? I thought it was because I've been eating too much fried chicken and getting hot from it...
The Bureau's temperature is constant, to try to meet the diverse needs of Sinners and staff, different temperatures are manually adjusted in different places.

However, for some reason, in recent times, there has been a day or two when the entire Bureau's temperature went up by several degrees, leaving people confused about whether or not to wear a coat to work.

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: Hey, Chief, could you help us get this system fixed when you have the time?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content:
Quack!
(Yes, sir!)
You readily agree, but turn around with a helpless smile.
At the door of the room, a cluster of sparks has just extinguished, pushing open the door, a wave of heat mixed with the distinct dry scent of the WhiteSands comes through.
A female wrapped in flames sits on the ground, her golden-red feathers shining with a special glow, making her look like a deity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's make a deal, next time you come, can you not let the Bureau's temperature rise so much?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: That's not possible I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Unless of course... I'm not too busy thinking about you.
